title: Presence by power — Acts 17 in Him we live
source_text: VII. Nam Deus per potentiam in omnibus esse dicitur, quoniam omnia producit, conservat & gubernat: & operatur omnia in omnibus: juxta illud Apostoli: Actor. 17. Non longe Deus est ab unoquoque nostrum, in ipso enim vivimus, movemur, & sumus.
pass_a_gloss: For God is said to be in all things by power, because He produces, preserves, and governs all things: and works all things in all: according to that of the Apostle: Acts 17. God is not far from each one of us, for in Him we live, and move, and are.
pass_b_english: By power: He produces, preserves, governs all.
Acts 17: not far — in Him we live, move, and are.

lemmas.gloss: to be in all things by power

lemmas.latin: in ipso enim vivimus, movemur, & sumus
